{{Quote|But why expect better from the Republic? That fool Captain Morvis is exactly who they are&mdash;no judgment, all ambition! At least Mandalorians believe in something, Zayne. Yes, they can be indiscriminate and brutal, but with our guidance. They can change. The Republic can't. We're on the wrong side!|Dorjander Kace, to [[Zayne Carrick]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic: War 3">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 3|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 3]]</ref>}}
The '''Mandalorian Knights''' were former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] who, during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], defied the orders of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and went to battle the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] under the command of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. However, unlike the [[Revanchist]]s, these rogue masters began covertly sabotaging the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] war effort under the direction of the maverick ex-council member [[Dorjander Kace]]. Having come to believe that the Republic was corrupt beyond redemption, Kace and his followers embraced the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] way of life. The Mandalorian Knights wield orange-bladed lightsabers.

==History==
{{Quote|Well, well. Captain Morvis and the young critic. Delighted to see you alive. Unlike your Republic, Mandalorians do have a use for prisoners. My Mandalorian Knights are volunteers, like me.|Dorjander Kace, to [[Dallan Morvis]] and Zayne Carrick|<ref name="KotOR War1" />}}
[[File:MandalorianKnights-KOTORW1.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kace and his followers reveal their true allegiance to [[Dallan Morvis]] and Zayne Carrick.]]
After his removal from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], [[Dorjander Kace]] came to the conclusion that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was irreparably corrupt and that the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] were far better suited for [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] dominion. Gathering a group of like-minded [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]], Kace became a double agent in the [[Mandalorian Wars]] for a brief period, serving as part of [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Revanchist|movement]] in appearance only, before his intentions were revealed by the [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]]. Kace and his newly-christened Mandalorian Knights ultimately joined [[Mandalore the Ultimate]] and his [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]] as the Mandalorians' counterpart to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the war. During his long-awaited [[Raid on Dantooine|infiltration]] of the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in [[3962 BBY]], the Mandalorian Knights surrendered and were returned to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] for trial.<ref name="KotOR War1" />
